newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dip in dollar sparks some European feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: Dip in dollar sparks some European feeds trade.

text.p: A dip in the dollar this afternoon and an easier Chicago soycomplex futures opening sparked some activity on the European meals and feeds market.

"The lower dollar attracted some buying interest while the weaker Chicago opening prompted sellers to take some profit in soymeal, which led to a bit of business ahead of the weekend," one broker said.

Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $292 a tonne fob Rotterdam, Jan at $286 a tonne cif and March at $273 cif. Jan and Feb Dutch high protein soymeal fetched $315 a tonne fob Rotterdam, March at $311 and May/Oct at $270 a tonne fob.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
